title: Mathematical Methods: Fourier, PDEs, Special Functions, Green's Functions, Variational Calculus, Tensors
subject: Math Methods
summary: The working toolkit of theoretical physics, following Boas: Fourier series and transforms, the delta function, separation of variables for the Laplace, heat and wave equations in Cartesian, cylindrical and spherical coordinates, gamma, Legendre, Bessel and Hermite/Laguerre functions, Sturm-Liouville theory, Green's functions, the calculus of variations and tensors. Chemistry hooks: FT-NMR/FTIR, particle in a box, hydrogen orbitals (Legendre/Laguerre), vibrating-membrane analogues, the variational principle.
